title: Le Voyage dans la Lune / A Trip to the Moon (1902), Georges Méliès
contents: Astronomers load the shell into the giant cannon, it fires, and the rocket lands in the Man in the Moon's eye — the most famous shot in early cinema.
license: US: PD (published 1902). Korea: PD — Méliès died 1938, and films are protected 70 years from publication (Art. 42). This archive copy is a B&W print; the hand-coloured 2011 restoration is a separate, copyrighted restoration — not used.
audio: removed: the archive copies carry modern added soundtracks of unclear copyright, so these are delivered silent; put PD music (oldmusic/) or Shorts-library audio over them
